warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Brand is set on two lines on the front, 'BENT' arched over '301'.
Front's bottom strip reads '45% ALC/VOL  •  90 PROOF  •  750 mL'; the alcohol wording is '45% ALC/VOL' and the net contents wording is '750 mL' with a lower-case 'm' and capital 'L'.
Warning is on the back, body in capitals, justified across nine lines.
